description: This file defines interfaces and data structures for Android's ADB authentication framework, including transport types, callback structures, and functions for managing authentication contexts and device connections.

methods.name: adbd_auth_new
methods.description: Creates a new authentication context with specified callbacks.

methods.name: adbd_auth_run
methods.description: Starts the authentication process, runs indefinitely.

methods.name: adbd_auth_get_public_keys
methods.description: Iterates through authorized public keys, invoking callback for each.

methods.name: adbd_auth_notify_auth
methods.description: Notifies system server of successful key authentication, returns connection ID.

methods.name: adbd_auth_notify_disconnect
methods.description: Notifies system server of disconnection of a device.

methods.name: adbd_auth_prompt_user
methods.description: Prompts user to authorize a public key.

methods.name: adbd_auth_prompt_user_with_id
methods.description: Prompts user with a specific ID for authorization.

methods.name: adbd_auth_tls_device_connected
methods.description: Informs system server of a TLS device connection.

methods.name: adbd_auth_tls_device_disconnected
methods.description: Informs system server of a TLS device disconnection.

methods.name: adbd_auth_get_max_version
methods.description: Returns the maximum supported version of the auth callbacks.

methods.name: adbd_auth_supports_feature
methods.description: Checks if a specific feature is supported by the framework.
